CORAM: HON'BLE MRS JUSTICE P SREE SUDHA  ORAL JUDGMENT 1.

This appeal is filed by the claimant against the Judgment and award dated 21.03.2020 passed in MVC No.713/2016 by Senior Civil Judge and JMFC and MACT, Aurad-B (for short 'the tribunal')
seeking enhancement of the compensation.
2. The injured-claimant aged 47 years working as Arabic Teacher, met with accident on 06.07.2016.
He filed claim petition seeking compensation of Rs.7,15,000/-, before the tribunal.
After considering the entire evidence on record, the tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.32,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realization.
Aggrieved by the said order, this appeal is preferred by the claimant in which it is contended that, the claimant was earning a sum of Rs.12,000/- per month.
He examined the Doctor.

The Doctor NC:
2025:KHC-K:6648 HC-KAR issued disability certificate which is marked at Ex.P.8.
In the disability certificate the Doctor has assessed 20% disability to the whole body, but the tribunal has not considered the same.
Therefore, requests for enhancement of the compensation.
3. Though the petitioner has stated that, he was earning a sum of Rs.12,000/- per month, he has not filed any income proof to prove his income.
The claimant met with accident on 06.07.2016.
As per the guidelines issued by the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority, the income of the claimant is to be taken at Rs.8,750/- per month.

As per the disability certificate, the claimant sustained (i)
Lacerated contused wound of upper lip; (ii) Abrasion over left leg; (iii) Right incisior tooth fallen,
which is grievous in nature.

In the disability certificate it is observed that, there is complete exfoliation of right maxillary central, Incisior including root of the tooth, as such the claimant is unable to bite food properly and he cannot speak properly and thus, the disability is assessed at 20%.
Admittedly, the claimant was a teacher and it affects his profession.

Therefore, this Court NC:
2025:KHC-K:6648 HC-KAR finds it reasonable to consider the disability at 1/3rd of 20% which comes to 7% for the purpose of calculation.

Hence, loss of earning capacity comes to:
Rs.8,750/- X 12 X 13 X 7% = Rs.95,550/-

sentences.text: The tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.5,000/- as medical expenses.

This Court finds it reasonable to award a sum of Rs.15,000/- towards pain and sufferings, Rs.15,000/- towards loss of amenities,
Rs.15,000/- towards transportation, extra nourishment and attendant charges and Rs.15,000/-
towards injuries.
He might have not attended any work at least for a period of two months.

Hence,
he is entitle for Rs.17,500/- (Rs.8,750/- X 2) towards loss of income during laid up period.

The total compensation is as under:
